prompts: Use case logo-brand. Create an original premium brand symbol exploration board for industrial energy decision-support company WattTrace. CRITICAL: SYMBOL MUST BE COMPLETELY NON-ALPHABETIC. No W, T, WT, initials, monogram, letterform, calligraphy, typographic symbol or hidden letters. The separate wordmark must read exactly "WattTrace" and must NOT determine the shape of the symbol. No lightning bolts, gears, leaves, shields, circuit diagrams, stock infinity marks, arrows or generic geometric badges. Sophisticated organic form with a strong memorable silhouette, restrained and proprietary-looking, suitable for one solid ink color and small app icon. Landscape board 1536x1024. Flat latte #F0E6DB background, espresso #44312E and deep blueberry #353455 inks, pale blueberry #D7D6EC. Main upper area large standalone symbol with generous negative space. Separate modest refined wordmark to its right. Lower row: symbol small in one color, reversed cream on blueberry, and a restrained small navbar lockup showing symbol plus WattTrace. All repetitions use IDENTICAL symbol. Beautiful optical spacing, no gradients or 3D effects. Only text is specified title and WattTrace. These are original forms, do not copy any existing brand. Title "01 / THE CONFLUENCE". Symbol: three broad organic streams of unequal lengths come together into one compact flowing form, separated by two deep curved negative-space channels that remain legible. Think water resolving through a narrow passage, viewed from above, captured in a sculpted ink silhouette. Asymmetric, grounded, gently horizontal, broad terminals, few bold curves. No circle, no swirl, no wave letter, no pointed flame. Quiet power and evidence brought together. Distinct from a yin-yang or recycling mark.
